about: The state machines and the workflow: research stages of a topic, production stages of a story, the board's columns (who acts next), the halt kinds, and the 25-step workflow a person follows, with the person's steps marked.
authority: src/orchestration/research.ts (RESEARCH_STAGES), src/orchestration/production.ts (PRODUCTION_STAGES, COLUMNS, HALT_KINDS, stoppedOf), src/orchestration/run/journal.ts (RUN_HALT_KINDS), src/admin/index.astro (flow)
principle: State is derived at read from the committed artifacts; the board (production.ts) is the one state machine; every halt has a kind and a next step that names a command or a brief, so /produce and the runner never parse prose.

researchStages.entity: a topic (npm run board -- topic; npm run run -- topic)

stages.needs: an approved proposals/<slug>.json (the one input the pipeline reads)
videos.txt and blogs.txt (collect.md agent: evidence -- search)
the watcher fetched the videos into the store (npm run watcher)
extract.md agents per group wrote work/h*.json; npm run record consumed them (recorded.json)
merge.md wrote merges.json and distinct.json; npm run merge-claims; dedupe, collide
studies.md fetched documents (fetch-doc), sources.md agents judged (sv_*.json), record-sources; thin after two empty rounds parks
npm run report wrote report.json; revision-note.md explains each revised finding (report -- note)
npm run topics -- claim put the topic under its commission in site.ts; npm run brand
npm run stories -- discover wrote stories.json (derived) and ran the evidence gate
stories.md reviewer wrote story-review.json (applicability, pruning, chains, targetDurationSeconds)

stages.means: at least one story is ready for production
thin, or the review kept no story; topics -- park with the reasons; no mail, a digest line

halts: needs-person (a record-sources refusal on a cited pair, or no approved proposal)

productionStages.entity: a story's video (npm run board -- next; npm run run -- story; /produce)

stages.by: npm run script -- package (code, from the corpus)
writer agent (script.md); sections hook, setup, investigation, answer, takeaway, or hook, question-N, close for a chain
npm run script -- validate (assertions per claim, figures trace to passages, pacing, duration band)
writer agent (storyboard.md): scenes with numeric chart points, cites, timing per sentence
graphics agent (graphics.md), visual reviewer (visual-review.md), npm run video -- check
npm run script -- lock (release-check.ts); an automated lock is approved by 'automated: /produce run started by <name>'
npm run video -- init | narrate (edge-tts) | timeline | render (Remotion) | qa (fit guard, runtime)

stages.means: every scene rendered against the locked fingerprints, QA passed, no soundtrack yet

stages.by: npm run music -- cues; the PCM mixer in a full render
writer (article.md), a different reviewer (article-review.md), npm run article -- validate | lock
npm run video -- package; then the private upload and the review

afterPackaged: draft upload (private) and the draft request by policy (review.draft: person | shadow | agent)
video final --approved-by (Azure voice, the release build; also the answer to look-stale)
shorts discover, shorts.md reviewer, a nested run per ready candidate (at most 3)
cta.md agent chooses the calls to action; a paid one needs a person
every output uploaded private, pushed, verified; packaging -- manifest; publish request --channel email
the person decides (OK, OK at <when>, CHANGES:, PAID OK); publish decide applies it: approved, push, sync, and for OK at the schedule; an OK leaves the video private

the launch job: report -- seed, brand, build, links freeze, validate, commit, push (the page before the video); the tick probes the deploy, goes live under the decision and verifies; Shorts follow in order; then the X post and the launch mail
productionStages.stopped: red on the board only for revision-limit, story-left, a stop: step or a failed publishing step; every other halt is its next step

boardColumns.about: one row per video; the column says who acts next; a chain's follow-up has no row; a Short's row sits under its parent

columns.means: the story's evidence is not ready

columns.actor: the production pick or a person
a person or, by policy, the draft-review agent

columns.means: the release package awaits the decision
live; a re-release is a new output
production.json parked, or a rejected story

workflow.about: the diagram on /admin (flow in src/admin/index.astro), condensed from its 31 boxes to 25 steps (the Studio upload fallback, the X post and the Short's start are folded into their neighbours): what runs and where a person acts; the order is the order of a release

steps.runs: run -- discover: an agent proposes per institution, an independent agent reviews, the weak are parked
one batch mail a week; reply APPROVE/REJECT, or topics -- approve|reject
run -- topic: collect, watcher fetch, extract per group, merge, dedupe, collide, record
studies fetch-doc, sources agents judge, record-sources; thin parks
report, then a note per changed finding

steps.t: Claim the topic for its institution
steps.runs: topics -- claim into site.ts, brand; a person adds a new institution
stories discover + evidence audit; stories.md review; ready or parked
the production pick, or a person: run -- story or /produce

steps.t: Read the blocked email, run the unblock
steps.runs: the tick mails each new halt once with the one command, reply or edit
evidence package; writer; different reviewer; validate; 3 revisions
storyboard.md; graphics.md per bespoke scene; visual-review.md; render check; lock
video init, music cues, edge voice, Remotion render, mix, QA
writer, different reviewer, validate, lock; the private package

steps.t: Watch it: the draft email or the review page
steps.runs: reply OK or CHANGES:, or decide on the page; or an agent by policy
Azure neural voice, timeline, render, QA; the release package
cta.md agent; checked by cta.ts against the content graph
PAID OK in the reply or links -- cta approve
shorts discover; shorts.md agent
a nested run per candidate, at most 3, portrait 1080x1920
each output private; the release manifest; one email
reply OK, OK at <when>, CHANGES:, PAID OK; or the review page; binds the manifest sha
publish decide: approved, push, sync; OK at hands YouTube the time; OK leaves the video private

steps.t: Deploy the page, then go live (the launch job, the tick)
steps.runs: seed, brand, build, freeze, validate, commit, push; the tick probes the deploy, goes live under the decision, verifies; Shorts in order; then post on X and the launch mail
related video, end screen, cards; recorded with publish -- updated

steps.t: Scan for new evidence (monthly); reaffirm or correct; approve the correction
steps.runs: run -- maintain; a correction request mails the person; OK releases it
